context.transcript:
Welcome to Plaza Apartments.
How can I help you?
Good morning.
A friend told me that this building was just completed and I'm looking for somewhere to live in this area.
Great.
We have several units available.
What size are you looking for?
I don't have much furniture, so a one-bedroom is fine, but I'd really like a unit with a nice view.
Oh, well, one of our available apartments has a room with a large window that overlooks our courtyard.
Here's the floor plan.
Wonderful.
That's just what I'm looking for.
Do you have some time right now?
I can show it to you.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到 Plaza Apartments。
我能帮您什么？
早上好。
一位朋友告诉我，这座大楼刚刚竣工，我在寻找这个区域的住处。
太好了。
我们有几个单元可供选择。
您想要多大的尺寸呢？
我没有太多家具，所以一居室就行，但我真的很喜欢带漂亮景观的单元。
哦，我们的可用公寓中有一个房间，有一扇大窗户，可以俯瞰我们的庭院。
这是平面图。
太棒了。
这正是我想要的。
您现在有时间吗？
我可以给您看看。
